name: fresh-alpha
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun -e 'import {proveSetFast,proveLaws} from "./kernel/prove.ts"; import {checkLaws} from "./kernel/kernel.ts"; import {lockServerSized,lockServerSizedLaws,lockServerUnrestrictedLaws} from "./research/bapa/lock-server-sized.ts"; const a=lockServerSized(); const al=[...a.kindLaws(),...lockServerSizedLaws(a)]; const first=proveSetFast(a.machine,al); const b=process.env.SAME_RULE ? a : lockServerSized(); const bl=[...b.kindLaws(),...lockServerUnrestrictedLaws(b)]; const fast=proveSetFast(b.machine,bl); const fallback=proveLaws(b.machine,bl); console.log(JSON.stringify({sameRule:!!process.env.SAME_RULE,alpha:process.env.GDP_MEMO_ALPHA??"default",first:{proven:first.proven,checked:first.checked},fast:{proven:fast.proven,checked:fast.checked,failed:fast.failed},fallback:{proven:fallback.proven,checked:fallback.checked,rechecked:!!fallback.proof&&checkLaws(b.machine,bl,fallback.proof),failed:fallback.failed}},null,2));' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/comparison.json"
